note: Cleft palate typically has lower penetrance than milder craniofacial manifestations like bifid uvula and hypertelorism in LDS, though published SMAD2 cohorts remain small.

evidence.text: SMAD2 is recognized as an LDS-associated gene where the typical triad includes hypertelorism and bifid/broad uvula or cleft palate, but detailed individual frequency breakdowns remain limited in summary updates.

source.title: A mutation update on the LDS‐associated genes TGFB2/3 and SMAD2/3
source.quote: Most typically, LDS patients present with aortic aneurysms and arterial tortuosity, hypertelorism, and bifid/broad uvula or cleft palate.

evidence.text: For SMAD2, relatively few mutation-positive individuals have been published to date to fully characterize the phenotypic spectrum and precise feature penetrance.
